exactEvidenceSummary: Audience-response data was only partly visible in this capture. The clearest visible response signals came from the November 10, 2025 ACA post and the March 3, 2025 Oakley town-hall post. The Lawrence Times later quoted Marshall saying, "I don’t have firsthand evidence" ([source](https://lawrencekstimes.com/2025/03/07/marshall-paid-ops-concerned-kansans/)).

His multiple campaign websites (at least four different domains) suggest organizational chaos.
